question: Select the synonym of **Defer.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Delay**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Defer"** means to postpone or delay something to a later time. (स्थगित करना)

 

 
• **Example:** The meeting was deferred until next week due to scheduling conflicts.

 

 
• **"Delay"** refers to causing something to be later or slower than expected; it is closely related to the meaning of "defer." (विलंब करना)

 

 
• **Example:** The heavy traffic caused a delay in their arrival.

 

 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Defer"** is **"Delay."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Delay**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Decline** (अस्वीकार करना): To refuse or reject something.

 

 
• **Example:** She politely declined the invitation to the party.

 

 

 
• **Reject** (ठुकराना): To refuse to accept, consider, or agree to something.

 

 
• **Example:** The application was rejected due to incomplete information.

 

 

 
• **Proceed** (आगे बढ़ना): To continue or move forward in an action or process.

 

 
• **Example:** After the announcement, the meeting proceeded as planned.
